OPEN QUESTION: format not yet finalised while LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH is still intake_complete — implementation must verify against the landed marker format.
- Q: Which components consume the attribution? Answer (item ACs): log_parser.py, bucketing.py/reporting.py, analyze_mode_flips.py. Final: all three, per the ACs.
